style: Warm industrial flat vector illustration in anthracite (#1e2124), heat orange (#ff7a1a) and white, clean pipes and curves, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a completely plain, smooth engine cover (absolutely no emblem, no badge, no letter, no symbol anywhere); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: An exhaust and muffler shop interior: a car on a lift seen from the side with its exhaust system exposed, new mufflers and pipes stacked on a rack, a pipe-bending machine, orange work lights. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK anthracite overall, heat-orange highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
